replacements.Feedback loop desde señales de producció: Feedback loop from production signals to eval, repair, and live verification
replacements.Un fallo de producción sólo entra al eva: A production failure enters the eval only when its mechanism is reproducible
replacements.La señal detecta; el trace reconstruye;: The signal detects; the trace reconstructs; the taxonomy proposes a cause; the minimal case makes it falsifiable; the regression gate validates the repair; production confirms whether the failure family actually stopped recurring.
replacements.Diagrama desplazable del feedback loop p: Scrollable diagram of the production, eval, repair, and verification feedback loop
replacements.Feedback loop de producción a eval y rep: Feedback loop from production to eval and repair
replacements.Señales de producción alimentan reconstr: Production signals feed reconstruction and taxonomy. If evidence is insufficient, instrumentation is improved. If the mechanism is reproducible, the case is redacted and minimized, deduplicated with neighbors, added to a versioned eval, repaired, passed through regression and controlled deployment, and closed only after production verification.
replacements.si no puedes explicar el evento: when you cannot explain the event
replacements.no inventes root cause: do not invent a root cause
replacements.4 · REPARACIÓN Y RELEASE — PASS ≠ LOOP C: 4 · REPAIR AND RELEASE — PASS ≠ CLOSED LOOP
replacements.una métrica o trace inicia una investiga: a metric or trace starts an investigation; it does not pass or fail the system by itself. If you cannot reproduce the mechanism, improve instrumentation. If you can, minimize and redact the case, protect the equivalence class with neighbors, version the verifier, and close the loop only after the repair returns to production and the failure family stops recurring under trustworthy observation.
